profile.overview: Simic Combine is the green-blue Ravnican guild where biology, adaptation, medicine, clades, and experimental improvement overlap.
profile.philosophy: Life starts from nature and can be studied, healed, adapted, and improved through bounded biological research.
profile.core_tension: Simic keeps a connection to nature while pursuing improvement; under pressure that can become radical intervention rather than generic science, mechanics, or nature aesthetics.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guide presents Simic as reclusive scientists, physicians, surgeons, public-health maintainers, clade researchers, and zonot-based communities.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Adapt is Simic mechanics texture for biological improvement; counters and other UG mechanics do not prove Simic identity without the source-bounded living-system frame.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

core_identity.summary: Simic Combine is the green-blue Ravnican guild where life is studied, healed, adapted, and improved through biological research and clade practice.
core_identity.philosophy: Natural connection is the starting point; deliberate adaptation and improvement are the Simic method.
core_identity.central_tension: Simic balances nature, public health, and incremental improvement against the risk of radical biological intervention.

site_surface.tagline: Life studied as an adaptive, improvable system.

structure.summary: The official guide presents Simic as reclusive scientists, physicians, surgeons, clade-organized researchers, and zonot communities working on biological research and public health.

great_tension.summary: Simic begins from nature and public health, but its improvement impulse can move from careful adaptation into radical biological intervention.
great_tension.placement_relevance: Used to distinguish Simic living-system adaptation from generic UG value, Izzet experimentation, Quandrix abstraction, Selesnya preservation, Witherbloom life/death craft, and other UG-adjacent overfit.
